name: register_driver

provenance.source: IDA sub_C4F0108; inode_lock(sub_C37ABF8) -> inode_reserve(sub_C4F0044, path) -> set inode->u.i_ops=@+16, i_flags type=1, i_private=@+28 -> inode_unlock(sub_C37BEF4).

notes: NuttX fs/driver/fs_registerdriver.c. ABI DIFFERENCE vs band-10 (int(const char*,const void*,uint32_t,void*)): band-9 register_driver DROPS the mode_t argument (3-arg). r3 mode is ignored when called with band-10's 4-arg convention, so calling band-9 sub_C4F0108 from band-10-style call sites is ABI-compatible. register_blockdriver = sub_C4DB968 (type 2). Matches band-10 register_driver 0x0C1A0D50.
